secure_mail_loaded:
    type: event
    description: >
      Triggers when different kinds of secure emails are loaded.
    bugs:
      - https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1615994
      - https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1899602
      - https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1867271
    data_reviews:
      - https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1615994#c22
    data_sensitivity:
      - technical
    notification_emails:
      - telemetry-client-dev@thunderbird.net
    expires: never
    extra_keys:
      security:
        description: Security technology. "OpenPGP" or "S/MIME".
        type: string
      is_signed:
        description: Whether the email was digitally signed.
        type: boolean
      is_encrypted:
        description: Whether the email was encrypted.
        type: boolean

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Current secureMailLoaded records from smimeprocessed on window and openpgpprocessed on document. Each handler reads the complete signed and encrypted state, ignores a message with neither state, then dispatches SecureMailLoaded for consumers. Generic MsgLoaded is too early for asynchronous signature verification. The 2024 migration used a first-read gate and separate signed/encrypted keys; later accepted code supersedes both. Only the relevant later file changes and current tests were read; their later bugs and reviews remain for their chronological batches. This study did not measure live event ordering.
title: Collect secure-mail telemetry after crypto processing completes
